description: A 40x40 solid box with filter: brightness(1.3) contrast(1.4) saturate(0.5) -- a real ordered filter chain of non-blur functions, proving the chain composes in authored order and each function's own real-CSS formula matches Chromium's.

florui.css: .box { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #8040c0; filter: brightness(1.3) contrast(1.4) saturate(0.5); }

classification.reason: Measured directly against a real Chromium capture: roughly 44% of pixels differ by exactly 1 of 255 color levels (max_error 1) -- a systematic rounding-mode difference between this crate's own filter-chain math and Chromium's, not a real color mismatch (a flat fill with the wrong formula would show a large, uniform error across every pixel, not a 1-level diff on less than half of them).
